# Receiver 046D:C547 ("USB Receiver") with a HID++ 1.0 device on index 1.
#
# Synthetic transcript: frames built from the layouts in Linux
# drivers/hid/hid-logitech-hidpp.c (short 0x10 reports, 0x8F HID++ 1.0 error,
# battery registers 0x07 / 0x0D) and Solaar lib/logitech_receiver
# (base.py ping, hidpp10_constants.py NotificationFlag.BATTERY_STATUS and
# Registers.BATTERY_STATUS / BATTERY_CHARGE). Replace with a real capture in
# Task 14.
#
# Format: `out <short|long> <hex>` is a frame BatterySight writes, `in` one it
# reads; frames shorter than their role (7 / 20 bytes) are zero-padded. The
# `out` lines after an `in` are the writes that frame causes.

# Group arrival: read the receiver's notification flags.
out short 10 FF 81 00 00 00 00
# Wireless notifications already on: no write.
in  short 10 FF 81 00 00 01 00
# Ask the receiver to report every paired slot (register 0x02 = 0x02, Solaar
# receiver.py notify_devices) ...
out short 10 FF 80 02 02 00 00
# ... refused (error 0x02, synthetic): fall back to pinging every slot.
in  short 10 FF 8F 80 02 02 00
out short 10 01 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 02 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 03 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 04 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 05 00 1B 00 00 5A
out short 10 06 00 1B 00 00 5A
# Index 1: error 0x01 (invalid sub id) -> HID++ 1.0; read register 0x00.
in  short 10 01 8F 00 1B 01 00
out short 10 01 81 00 00 00 00
in  short 10 02 8F 00 1B 08 00
in  short 10 03 8F 00 1B 08 00
in  short 10 04 8F 00 1B 08 00
in  short 10 05 8F 00 1B 08 00
in  short 10 06 8F 00 1B 08 00
# Battery reporting off: set only bit 0x10 of the first byte.
in  short 10 01 81 00 00 00 00
out short 10 01 80 00 10 00 00
in  short 10 01 80 00 00 00 00
# Register 0x0D (battery charge) is not supported: error 0x02 ...
out short 10 01 81 0D 00 00 00
in  short 10 01 8F 81 0D 02 00
# ... so read register 0x07 (battery status): level 5 (good), discharging.
out short 10 01 81 07 00 00 00
in  short 10 01 81 07 05 00 00
# Register 0x07 notification: level 3 (low), no write.
in  short 10 01 07 03 00 00 00
